entities.name: House Cecani
entities.description: One of the three most prestigious human noble houses of Gavony, wealthy landowners and devout Avacynians.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: Innistrad's dominant church, led by the Lunarch.

entities.name: Gisa Cecani
entities.description: Necromancer ghoulcaller who raises the dead into mindless armies; twin of Geralf.

entities.name: Geralf III Cecani
entities.description: Skaberen who stitches together skaabs from corpses; twin brother of Gisa.

entities.name: Gretchen Cecani
entities.description: Matriarch of the family and mother of the twins.

entities.name: Mikaeus Cecani
entities.description: Cousin of the twins and Lunarch, killed by Geralf and raised as an undead horror by Liliana Vess.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who raised Mikaeus as an undead horror.

entities.name: Trostad
entities.description: Town ruined by the twins' rivalry.

events.summary: Necromancer twins Gisa and Geralf bring disgrace to House Cecani and ruin the town of Trostad.
events.quote: complete ruin to the town of Trostad

events.summary: Geralf kills his cousin Mikaeus, the Lunarch.
events.quote: after his death at the hands of his cousin Geralf

events.summary: Liliana Vess raises Mikaeus as an undead horror.
events.quote: Mikaeus was later raised as an undead horror by the planeswalker Liliana Vess

relations.quote: after his death at the hands of his cousin Geralf
served as the Lunarch, the supreme spiritual leader of the Church of Avacyn
Gisa Cecani – a ghoulcaller who revels in raising the dead for her own amusement and petty wars with her brother.
